title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust provides a standardized, reproducible protocol for evaluating trust in embodied navigation systems.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking captures real-world variability, ensuring models are tested across diverse environments and failure scenarios.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates specific metrics like path fidelity and safety, offering a unified framework for comparing agent behavior.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking evolves with new challenges, unlike static protocols that can become outdated as technology advances.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Without benchmarking, NavTrust is just a theoretical ideal—untested and disconnected from practical deployment needs.
